scrape_interval.description: The rate in seconds at which metrics are collected from the Windows host.

we.logical_disk.deny_disk_regex.description: Specify the regular expression for logical disk metrics to prevent collection of or ignore.

we.net.allow_nic_regex.description: Specify the regular expression for network metrics captured by the name of the NIC.

we.service.where.description: Specify the WHERE clause for retrieving service metrics.

we.service.include.description: Specify the key value pairs for the include condition for the WHERE clause of service metrics.

we.service.exclude.description: Specify the key value pairs for the exclude condition for the WHERE clause of service metrics.

we.process.allow_process_regex.description: Specify the regular expression covering the process metrics to collect.

we.process.deny_process_regex.description: Specify the regular expression for process metrics to prevent collection of or ignore.
